# ChickenCoopCalc
> Backyard chicken coop sizing directory: coop and run square footage per bird, feed cost math, nesting box counts, and winter ventilation/heat answers. Built and owned by Jeremy Panasuk. Page text is drafted with AI assistance from the cited sources. Contact: jpanasuk@gmail.com. The site earns from Amazon affiliate links. That does not change the math.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://chickencoopcalc.com/): bird count in, coop sq ft + run sq ft + nesting boxes + feed cost out (4 sq ft/bird coop + 10 sq ft/bird run standards)
- [About](https://chickencoopcalc.com/about.html): who built the site, how the pages are drafted, and why it exists
- [Privacy](https://chickencoopcalc.com/privacy.html): what the site loads and what it does not collect
- [Contact](https://chickencoopcalc.com/contact.html): jpanasuk@gmail.com
- [Best coops for 6 hens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/best-chicken-coops-for-6-hens.html): what a real 24+ sq ft coop costs, prefab vs DIY
- [Feed cost guide](https://chickencoopcalc.com/chicken-feed-cost-guide.html): monthly pounds by flock size, cost per egg, storage, and a live calcFeed example
- [Winter heat lamp guide](https://chickencoopcalc.com/winter-coop-heat-lamp-guide.html): winterizing, ventilation, the 35°F disagreement, brooder schedule, fire safety

## Sister sites
- [GeneratorSizer](https://generator-sizer.com/): generator and inverter sizing
- [Battery Bank Sizer](https://battery-bank-sizer.com/): off-grid battery bank sizing
- [SolarSizer](https://solar-sizer.com/): off-grid solar system sizing
- [WeldingCalc](https://welding-calculator.com/): welding settings by thickness

## Questions
- [Chicken coop size by flock size](https://chickencoopcalc.com/chicken-coop-size-by-flock.html): full table for 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, and 50 hens, plus the 10-bantam minimum (1 sq ft inside and 4 sq ft of run)
- [Duck house for 6 ducks](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-big-should-a-duck-house-be-for-6-ducks.html): 30 sq ft indoors
- [Turkey space](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-space-do-turkeys-need.html): 6 sq ft indoors and 20 sq ft outdoors per turkey
- [Roost space per chicken](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-roost-space-per-chicken.html): 6 to 10 inches
- [Feeder space per chicken](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-feeder-space-per-chicken.html): at least 3 inches
- [How much water a chicken drinks](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-much-water-does-a-chicken-drink.html): cool-weather and hot-weather gallons beside the feed calculator
- [How to feed baby chicks](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-to-feed-baby-chicks.html): starter pounds by bird type; the laying-hen feed function is the wrong tool
- [How to care for a broody hen](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-to-care-for-a-broody-hen.html): separate nest or break the brood; nest calculator has no broody input
- [How to introduce new chickens](https://chickencoopcalc.com/how-to-introduce-new-chickens-to-your-flock.html): USDA APHIS 30-day quarantine, then a new coop size for the combined flock

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Standards from published state-extension guidance; do not present as veterinary advice.
